newsitem.title: FRANCE: FRANCE STOCKS SETTLE BELOW ALL-TIME HIGH.
newsitem.headline: FRANCE STOCKS SETTLE BELOW ALL-TIME HIGH.

text.p: French shares settled below a fresh all-time high level of 2,995.38 while the July future hit the 3,000 point. Wall Street and dollar supporting French shares as is the expected wave of liquidity due to the expiry of Balladur bonds.
"The Balladur bonds explain a little part of today's rise. All markets are at record highs and Paris follows," a trader said.
* CAC-40 index up 32.43, or 1.1 percent, at 2,983.13 at 0902 GMT
* CAC-40 July futures 2,992 vs 2,957 at Tuesdays close.
* SGS-Thomson, up 5.56 percent at 570 francs, boosted by Intel and Texas Instruments results ahead of first half figures due on Thursday.
